mapper.sql: FROM sc_recharge_frequency_entry e JOIN sc_recharge_frequency_queue q ON q.id=e.queue_id LEFT JOIN sc_platform_spu s ON s.id=q.platform_spu_id LEFT JOIN sc_supply_chain_order o ON o.id=e.order_id LEFT JOIN sc_buyer b ON b.id=e.buyer_id LEFT JOIN sc_buyer_project p ON p.id=e.project_id WHERE e.status=#{f.getWaitingStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sc_recharge_frequency_entry WHERE status=#{f.getWaitingStatus}) waiting_order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sc_recharge_frequency_queue WHERE holder_entry_id IS NOT NULL OR blocked_reason IS NOT NULL) occupied_queue_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT queue_id FROM sc_recharge_frequency_entry WHERE status=#{f.getWaitingStatus} GROUP BY queue_id HAVING COUNT(*) > #{f.getBacklogThreshold}) backlog) over_threshold_queue_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sc_recharge_frequency_queue WHERE (holder_entry_id IS NOT NULL OR blocked_reason IS NOT NULL) AND acquired_at < TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,-#{f.getOccupiedAlertSeconds},#{f.observedAt})) overdue_queue_count, #{f.getSuccessMinimumHoldSeconds} success_minimum_hold_seconds, #{f.getOccupiedAlertSeconds} occupied_alert_seconds, #{f.getBacklogThreshold} backlog_threshold, #{f.observedAt} observed_at

SELECT e.id entry_id, e.queue_id, e.version, q.mobile_masked masked_mobile, s.spu_code platform_spu_code, s.spu_name platform_spu_name, e.order_no, o.buyer_order_no, e.buyer_id, b.buyer_code, b.buyer_name, e.project_id, p.project_code, p.project_name, e.enqueued_at, GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,e.enqueued_at,#{f.observedAt})) wait_seconds, e.enqueue_sequence queue_sequence
ORDER BY e.enqueued_at,e.queue_id,e.enqueue_sequence LIMIT #{f.pageSize} OFFSET #{f.getOffset}
mapper.sql:
FROM sc_recharge_frequency_queue q LEFT JOIN sc_platform_spu s ON s.id=q.platform_spu_id LEFT JOIN sc_recharge_frequency_entry h ON h.id=q.holder_entry_id LEFT JOIN sc_fulfillment_request r ON r.id=h.fulfillment_request_id LEFT JOIN sc_fulfillment_operation op ON op.operation_no=h.active_operation_no LEFT JOIN sc_b_order bo ON bo.id=op.b_order_id WHERE (q.holder_entry_id IS NOT NULL OR q.blocked_reason IS NOT NULL)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sc_recharge_frequency_entry e LEFT JOIN sc_supply_chain_order o ON o.id=e.order_id WHERE e.queue_id=q.id AND ((q.holder_entry_id IS NOT NULL AND e.id=q.holder_entry_id) OR (q.holder_entry_id IS NULL AND q.blocked_reason IS NOT NULL AND e.status=#{f.getHoldingStatus} AND e.dispatch_phase=#{f.getSendPossiblePhase})) )
mapper.select:
SELECT q.id queue_id, q.mobile_masked masked_mobile, s.spu_code platform_spu_code, s.spu_name platform_spu_name, h.order_no holder_order_no, q.acquired_at, q.minimum_hold_until, GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,q.acquired_at,#{f.observedAt})) held_seconds, (q.acquired_at < TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,-#{f.getOccupiedAlertSeconds},#{f.observedAt})) overdue, q.occupancy_generation generation, q.version, q.blocked_reason, r.status request_status, op.status operation_status, (bo.order_id=h.order_id AND bo.fulfillment_request_id=h.fulfillment_request_id AND h.occupancy_generation=q.occupancy_generation AND ((r.status=#{f.getSuccessStatus} AND op.status=#{f.getOperationSuccessStatus} AND op.result_class=#{f.getSuccessResult}) OR (r.status=#{f.getFailedStatus} AND op.status=#{f.getOperationFailedStatus} AND op.result_class=#{f.getRejectedResult}))) terminal_evidence, (bo.order_id=h.order_id AND bo.fulfillment_request_id=h.fulfillment_request_id AND r.status=#{f.getFulfillingStatus} AND h.occupancy_generation=q.occupancy_generation AND h.dispatch_phase=#{f.getPreparedPhase} AND op.status=#{f.getExecutingStatus} AND op.attempt_count=0 AND op.result_class IS NULL AND op.external_operation_no IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sc_fulfillment_operation other JOIN sc_b_order ob ON ob.id=other.b_order_id WHERE ob.order_id=h.order_id AND other.id != op.id AND other.operation_kind NOT IN (#{f.getQueryOrderKind},#{f.getQueryAssetKind}) AND NOT (other.status=#{f.getOperationFailedStatus} AND COALESCE(other.result_class,'')=#{f.getRejectedResult}) AND NOT (other.operation_kind=#{f.getFulfillKind} AND other.adapter_step_code IN (#{f.getSendStep},#{f.getSendKmStep}) AND other.status IN (#{f.getPendingStatus},#{f.getClaimedStatus}) AND other.attempt_count=0 AND other.result_class IS NULL AND other.external_operation_no IS NULL AND other.completed_at IS NULL AND ob.fulfillment_request_id=r.id AND ((ob.id=bo.id AND other.sequence_no > op.sequence_no) OR ob.attempt_no > bo.attempt_no)))) prepared_safe
ORDER BY q.acquired_at,q.id LIMIT #{f.pageSize} OFFSET #{f.getOffset}
mapper.sql:
FROM sc_recharge_frequency_queue q LEFT JOIN sc_platform_spu s ON s.id=q.platform_spu_id JOIN (SELECT queue_id,COUNT(*) waiting_count,MIN(enqueued_at) earliest_enqueued_at FROM sc_recharge_frequency_entry WHERE status=#{f.getWaitingStatus} GROUP BY queue_id) aggregate_waiting ON aggregate_waiting.queue_id=q.id WHERE 1=1
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sc_recharge_frequency_entry e LEFT JOIN sc_supply_chain_order o ON o.id=e.order_id WHERE e.queue_id=q.id AND e.status=#{f.getWaitingStatus} )
mapper.select:
SELECT q.id queue_id,q.mobile_masked masked_mobile,s.spu_code platform_spu_code,s.spu_name platform_spu_name, aggregate_waiting.waiting_count,aggregate_waiting.earliest_enqueued_at, (aggregate_waiting.waiting_count > #{f.getBacklogThreshold}) over_threshold
ORDER BY aggregate_waiting.waiting_count DESC,aggregate_waiting.earliest_enqueued_at,q.id LIMIT #{f.pageSize} OFFSET #{f.getOffset}
SELECT order_no FROM sc_recharge_frequency_entry WHERE queue_id=#{queueId} AND status=#{holdingStatus} AND dispatch_phase=#{sendPossiblePhase} ORDER BY enqueue_sequence
